prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square 1024x1024 fantasy CRPG spell icon, Magic Circle against Good. Input image 1 is the native single-target Protection from Good visual identity reference. Input image 2 is its Communal sibling, a distinction reference. Create an original painted icon recognizably belonging to THIS exact native Protection family. Preserve the identity of the central emblem: a bright gold-white sunburst with strong long tapering rays, like the attached Protection from Good central emblem. The new distinguishing motif is a complete broad circular enclosing boundary around that central emblem: two clean concentric luminous magical rings, visibly separated by a dark gap, suggesting a radius. Make the emblem large and readable in the center, rings at roughly 73% and 88% of image width, all fully visible with clear padding. The single-target icon has one enclosing rim; Communal has flaring streaks; this Magic Circle has two calm, unbroken concentric protective boundaries. Palette gold and warm amber, on the same deep blue-black/violet atmospheric background as the references. Luminous hand-painted game art with broad silhouettes and controlled highlights, not flat vector shapes. Strong legibility at 32, 48 and 64 pixels. Do not reproduce the source pixels; repaint the identity faithfully. No people, scenic buildings, dome, chain, prisoner, binding runes, text, letters, numbers, watermarks, UI frame, decorative square border or multiple panels. One finished icon only.
